text:
mira: Quick sync 	1: Sales asks for per-route concurrency guarantees as a pricing tier. Ops nervous. Thoughts?

dan: Per-route concurrency is doable as a soft limit (reservation + priority) but not a hard SLA without infra changes.

sophia_sales: Customers want "X concurrent connections" on high-throughput endpoints. They'd pay extra. We need a clear commercial product.

legal_amy: Legal: do not promise hard concurrency without SLA addendum. Language should be "target concurrency" or "priority concurrency subject to system health."

ops_julian: Operational plan: implement a route_concurrency reservation token that gives priority queue slots up to N. Enforcement: router hands token, serving enforces tokens per model shard. Fallback when exhausted -> queued or routed to best-effort.

mira: Example minimal config (for infra):
```
route_concurrency:
  id: rc_v1
  max_reserved: 200
  per_account_limit: 0.2   # max 20% of pool
  fallback: queue_then_best_effort
  emergency_reclaimable: true
```

ops_julian: We'll add telemetry: concurrent_slots_in_use, queue_time, reclaim_events. Also emergency reclaim endpoint and console panel.

sophia_sales: Commercial flavors: (A) Priority Concurrency (soft promise, cheaper), (B) Guaranteed Concurrency (SLA addendum, expensive). Sales needs pricing bands.

billing-bot: Ticket BILL-4412 created: pricing bands + invoice line for concurrency addon. Owner=billing, due=2025-05-28.

mira: Launch checklist (short): 1) API flag + billing tag, 2) console shows reserved slots and usage, 3) fallback behavior documented, 4) legal language approved, 5) pricing bands defined.

legal_amy: Contract blurb suggestion: "Concurrency Add-ons provide prioritized request handling up to the purchased concurrency level. This does not constitute a latency or availability guarantee unless an SLA addendum is executed."

ops_julian: We should cap per-customer reserved concurrency to avoid oversubscribe: default per-account max 20% of a region pool, global cap 30% of pooled capacity.

dan: Also note interactions with prepaid slabs and commits: reserved slots should consume slab units first if customer has route-bound slabs. Reconcile billing tags.

mira: OK. I'll draft a short spec + UI copy and loop in Sales/Finance. Target draft by Monday.

sophia_sales: I'll prepare a competitive sheet showing how other vendors price concurrency.

mira: Thanks. We'll reconvene after drafts.
